The '''Mk XII Smartgunner chip''' was a form of "intelligent" weapons control chip. It was developed during the early years of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], although they were never really mass-produced. These "smart chips" allowed weapons to be aimed and fired automatically, greatly reducing the need for gunners on a starship. [[Jorkatt]] the Render and [[Vohrkrewel Yahrkar]] tried to swindle [[Octavious Jupiter Scragg]] out of a huge pile of credits by selling him faked versions of these chips, but Yahrkar's personal droid discovered they were false and returned them.
